doc: One hex region of the ground a plot system fills (design/plotter.md, Describing cells and their attributes): a shape, a priority, and attribute values. A cell takes its values from the highest-priority region covering it.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: For cells: axial coordinates as q, r pairs.

fields.name: q
fields.doc: A hex's or ring's centre, or a line's start: axial q.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: A hex's or ring's radius, in cells.

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: Higher wins where regions overlap; equal priorities resolve in list order.

fields.name: cut
fields.doc: Removes the shape's cells from the region instead of adding them.

fields.name: set
fields.doc: Which attributes this region sets, as bits: 1 ground, 2 available, 4 keep_clear_m, 8 height, 16 moisture. Unset attributes come from lower regions (or the defaults: soil, available, 0, 0, 0.5).

fields.name: available
fields.doc: Whether anything with a footprint may stand here (false for a road, a building's plot).

fields.name: keep_clear_m
fields.doc: Keep everything that blocks at least this far from these cells' centres, metres.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Ground height at the cells' centres, metres.
